title: 2022 CODATA: molar mass constant is 1.000 000 001 05 × 10^−3
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives molar mass constant as 1.000 000 001 05 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 31 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives molar mass constant as 1.000 000 001 05 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1, with uncertainty 0.000 000 000 31 × 10^−3 kg mol^-1. The row is not marked exact. After the 2019 SI revision the molar mass constant is no longer fixed at exactly 1 g/mol. The 2022 listing gives a measured value with an uncertainty. This card reports that row. It does not claim a particular sample's molar mass.
